title: FoveaVLA: Foveation Actions Replace the Wrist Camera in VLAs
abstract: arXiv:2610.20064v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present FoveaVLA, a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that replaces the wrist camera with learned foveation actions. Wrist cameras provide close-up detail but restrict the view to the end-effector's surroundings. External cameras see the whole scene, but the policy receives them at low resolution, so the fine detail needed for manipulation is lost. FoveaVLA recovers this detail by predicting, alongside each action chunk, the interaction region to observe at the next policy query. The policy then receives crops of these regions, taken from the original-resolution images, together with the full views. We build FoveaVLA on $\pi_{0.5}$ in two configurations, Single and Dual, using one or two external stereo cameras with full and foveal RGB and depth inputs, and post-train both on DROID with RoboInter interaction annotations. Across four real-world task suites, FoveaVLA-Single achieves 70.8% success with one external RGB-D view,

translated_title: FoveaVLA：用注视动作替代视觉-语言-动作模型中的腕部相机
translated_abstract: 我们提出了FoveaVLA，这是一种用学习到的注视（foveation）动作取代腕部相机的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。腕部相机能提供近距离细节，但视野局限于末端执行器周围；外部相机可以看到整个场景，但策略接收到的图像分辨率较低，导致操作所需的精细细节丢失。FoveaVLA通过在预测每个动作块的同时，预测下一次策略查询时需要观察的交互区域来恢复这些细节。随后，策略会接收从原始分辨率图像中裁剪出的这些交互区域，并结合完整的视野图像。我们基于π0.5构建了FoveaVLA，包含Single和Dual两种配置，分别使用一个或两个外部立体相机，输入完整视野及注视区域的RGB和深度信息，并在带有RoboInter交互标注的DROID数据集上对两种配置进行后训练。在四个真实世界任务套件中，FoveaVLA-Single仅使用一个外部RGB-D视角就达到了70.8%的成功率。
tldr: FoveaVLA用可学习的注视动作替代腕部相机，在预测动作块的同时预测下一步需要观察的交互区域，并从原始分辨率图像中裁剪该区域供策略使用，从而在不牺牲全局视野的情况下恢复操作所需的精细细节。
en_tdlr: FoveaVLA replaces the wrist camera with learned foveation actions, predicting the interaction region to observe at each policy query and cropping it from original-resolution images, thereby recovering fine manipulation detail while retaining full-scene views.
